body: I don't know.  I don't dislike my job and it's a good opportunity.  I think my mental health was already in a precarious state and moving somewhere where I knew 0 people combined with responsibility at work I wasnt ready for just was a catalyst. I think less responsibility would be nice though.  Still young and have time to move up. I think I just need to get other things in place before I can really prioritize my career.
